one_line: Kashmiri Rishi-Sufi poet-saint whose shruks shaped Kashmiri spiritual and literary tradition.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, slim and ascetic but quietly strong, with a calm, grounded posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, light brown Kashmiri complexion, high cheekbones, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, soft thoughtful eyes with slight dark circles, default expression serene and introspective with a gentle half-smile.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair, straight and shoulder-length, parted in the middle, mostly hidden under a simple undyed woolen cap; cap is rounded, close-fitting, off-white with a subtle knit texture.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length Kashmiri pheran of coarse undyed wool in warm off-white, with long loose sleeves and a simple round neckline, layered over a slightly darker ash-grey wool under-tunic; a plain handwoven cotton sash in muted walnut-brown wraps once around his waist and ties at the side, its ends hanging down; loose straight woolen trousers in soft earthy beige tuck into simple dark brown leather shoes suitable for walking mountain paths; the pheran hem and cuffs have a very subtle narrow border in dull moss-green, suggesting local weaving without ornate patterns, and overall textiles look practical, slightly worn but carefully kept.
appearance.signature: A simple wooden staff about his height, made from a smooth, slightly curved branch with natural knots, its surface lightly polished by use, held or resting at his side as a symbol of a wandering, meditative life and honest labor.

ref_desc: Nund Rishi is a slim Kashmiri saint with an oval light-brown face, short beard, wool cap, off-white wool pheran over ash-grey tunic, beige trousers, brown shoes, moss-green trim, and a simple wooden staff, in soft earthy tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nund Rishi as a dignified Kashmiri Rishi-Sufi saint: a slim man in his late forties with an oval light-brown face, high cheekbones, straight nose, soft thoughtful eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing dark brown shoulder-length hair mostly hidden beneath a simple rounded off-white woolen cap. He is dressed in a knee-length off-white wool pheran with long loose sleeves and a plain round neckline, layered over an ash-grey wool under-tunic, the pheran hem and cuffs edged with a very narrow moss-green woven border. A muted walnut-brown handwoven cotton sash wraps once around his waist, tied at the side with its ends hanging, and he wears loose straight woolen trousers in earthy beige tucked into simple dark brown leather shoes. His one prop is a smooth, slightly curved wooden staff about his height, held calmly or resting at his side, symbolizing his wandering ascetic life. Use a soft earthy palette of off-white, ash grey, earthy beige, walnut brown, moss green, and deep brown, and show him from multiple angles to clearly present face, hair, clothing details, and staff in a modest, era-accurate Kashmiri mountain setting mood.
